Frequently Asked Questions

Is Word Unscrambler really free?

Yes, completely! There are no hidden fees, premium features, or paywalls. Word Unscrambler is free forever.

Do you collect my search data?

No. We don't track or store your searches. Your privacy is completely protected. See our Privacy Policy for details.

What dictionaries do you support?

We support ENABLE, TWL, and CSW dictionaries. This covers Scrabble, Wordle, Words with Friends, and other popular word games.

How fast are the results?

Results are typically returned in under 200ms, making Word Unscrambler one of the fastest tools available.
